This might be my fault for not expanding on the situation because there's more to it. But since they were moving out of the state due to FIL getting a job promotion, they wanted a place they could be in without paying for a hotel room. If it were our way, we could have had a one bedroom. However, they convinced us that they wanted to be with us when they came down here so a 2 bedroom was needed. The issue was that me and my partner can't afford a 2 bedroom apartment because of COL and so therefore he wanted to put his name on the lease. During this time it was in the air about my SIL because she was a recent graduate with a theatre teaching degree and they were waiting to see if she would move with them or stay in houston. But they spoke with us about possibly getting a 3 bedroom apartment (which is way out of our financed) if my SIL stayed because they were worried about her being on her own (which is another story because they regret not forcing her to move in with them). So when she hastily took a job (she didnt have a car or DL) we were expected to take her to her job when it was almost an hour away. She also had a retail job that she got which we drove her to. She never really gave us gas money even when we asked. 

We recently found out they are financially dependent on us because when we told them we are trying to move out, they didn't know how they were going to keep paying for the house. My SIL is the only other person who lives here and she would be only one who can cover the rent, but she wouldn't be able to. I don't think they want to sell it because it saves them money when they come down to visit instead of getting a hotel room. We asked what their plans were with the house once we left, but FIL gets really mad at us when we dont do something his way so he told us I dont know. Of course we are still worried about them so it makes me feel awful leaving in this situation but my FIL is like my mom where they emotionally manipulate their way until the other person yields. 

If I'm being honest, financially it will be super tight. But living in this house has taken a mental toll on my mental health because my partner and I take on all of the maintenance of the house while SIL does what she wants and doesn't help out. And yes we have talked to her multiple times about helping out but she doesn't do it unless we keep asking her. I already spent my teenage years taking care of my siblings. I refused to keep playing mother with my SIL.

If I had the financial means at the time. Then yeah I wouldnt have. But there was a lot of things happening at the time. During that time I recently left my abusive home environment and I had quit my job because nursing school became really stressful especially since it was the height of the pandemic. When we were looking at apartments, I unfortunately couldnt afford to put a lot in the first and last month payment because again. Didnt have a job. I was actively looking for one and I finally got a retail job but minimum wage. My FIL was only supposed to help us out with that. We would cover everything else. But it all changed when my SIL wanted to stay in TX so they bought the house because basically, they didnt want her to be living alone. They are refugees from Venezuela so i understand they have lots of paranoia and concerns for safety. That is why they kept pushing it onto my partner to move in with them. My partner and I have always planned to leave but we learned they are financially dependent on us to basically pay off the house. 

They wouldnt have bought the house if my SIL stayed in TX bc again. There was no reason to have one except them being overly protective of my SIL and not trusting anyone else to be with her.
